• Churchill Brothers SC vs East Bengal FC || Match Content || Highlights || Match 10 || 18-Oct-2026 ||
The champions are off and running! Watch the big moments as East Bengal FC thrashed Churchill Brothers SC 4-0 to open their MG Indian Super League 2026-27 title defence in Goa.
Dani Ramírez set the tone with a free kick in the second minute, and Edmund Lalrindika finished off David Lalhlansanga’s pass to make it two before the break. Bipin Singh came off the bench at half-time and struck twice in the final five minutes, set up by Aké Arnaud Loba and Vishnu PV, to complete the rout.
